facts.business: Kilburn Engineering Limited is a leading process engineering company engaged in the design, engineering, and manufacture of highly specialised process equipment and systems for critical industrial applications, spanning thermal engineering, waste heat recovery, Radio Frequency (RF) heating and drying technologies, and precision manufacturing.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capacity expansion, technology upgrades and operational efficiency

key_risks: Competitive Environment from domestic and international players
Project Execution and Cost Pressures including input cost fluctuations
Foreign Exchange Risk from export operations
Demand Cyclicality and Working Capital pressures
facts.related_party_note: The Company has utilized the fund raised through preferential allotment of Equity Shares and Convertible Warrants for the objects stated in the Explanatory Statement to the Notice of Extra Ordinary General Meeting dated 28th October, 2023 and 36th Annual General Meeting dated 20th September, 2024. Formation of Kilburn East End Private Limited (KEEPL) and Joint Venture Agreement with Eastend Engineering & Trading Private Limited (EETPL) for transfer of 40% equity stake in KEEPL.
